author: AlRome
quote:
This game is an absolute rugpull! Reminder that this site and Take-Two Interactive are owned by BlackRock! 

13 years and over 2 billion dollars spent on a boyfriend simulator. The games name is Grand Theft Auto and you can't properly steal cars, you can't harm protected class (a.k.a. the LGHDTV community), I stopped counting how many times I had to restart the game because of bugs, female NPCs can start crying and suddenly your character stops his current action, NPCs can attack you out of the blue but if you fight back you become wanted. 

R.I.P. GTA series, it's sad that even this series became a victim of the agenda!
